heroSummary: Frisco ISD’s 2026–27 school year starts Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and ends Friday, May 14, 2027. Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 4, and Spring Break is March 15–19. March 26 and April 16 are reserved as bad-weather make-up days; students are off unless the district uses either date to replace a canceled school day.

customSections.label: What Makes the 2026–27 Frisco ISD Calendar Different?

groups.label: The school year ends early for the PGA Championship
items: Frisco ISD will end school one week earlier than normal because the PGA Championship is expected to bring about 30,000 people per day to Frisco in May 2027. The district coordinated the change with the city and local police and fire departments because of expected transportation and crowding issues.

groups.label: Five minutes were added to each school day
items: To accommodate the shorter year and meet state instructional-minute requirements, Frisco ISD added five minutes to the school day at every grade level.

groups.label: October has five consecutive days without classes
items: Frisco ISD does not label a Fall Break. Students have no school Friday, October 9, and Monday–Tuesday, October 12–13, creating five consecutive days without classes when the weekend is included.

customSections.label: Breaks and No-School Days
customSections.content: A few dates on the 2026–27 calendar need extra context. Major break ranges appear in Key Dates above and in the full calendar.

groups.label: October No-School Days
items: Students have no school October 9 and October 12–13. With the weekend, this creates a five-day stretch without classes, although Frisco ISD does not name it Fall Break.

groups.label: Conditional Bad-Weather Make-Up Days
items: March 26 and April 16 are reserved as bad-weather make-up days. Students are off unless Frisco ISD uses either date to make up a canceled school day.

groups.label: Other No-School Dates
items: Other no-school dates are September 7–8, January 18, February 12 and 15, and April 30. With the weekend, the February dates give students four consecutive days without classes.

customSections.label: About This Frisco ISD Calendar

School-specific events, graduation details, bell schedules, and emergency changes may not appear on the districtwide PDF, so families should confirm campus details with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Frisco ISD start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Frisco ISD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 14, 2027. Frisco ISD is ending the school year one week earlier than normal because of transportation and crowding concerns related to the May 2027 PGA Championship.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Frisco ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Frisco ISD Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 4, 2027. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Frisco ISD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Frisco ISD have a Fall Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Frisco ISD does not label a Fall Break on its 2026–27 student calendar. Students have no school Friday, October 9, and Monday–Tuesday, October 12–13, creating a five-day stretch without classes when the weekend is included.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the Frisco ISD bad-weather make-up days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: March 26 and April 16, 2027 are reserved as bad-weather make-up days. Students are off unless Frisco ISD uses either date to make up a canceled school day.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does Frisco ISD end school early in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Frisco ISD moved the last day one week earlier because the PGA Championship is expected to bring significant transportation and crowding issues to Frisco in May 2027. The district added five minutes to each school day to help meet instructional-minute requirements.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official Frisco ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link above for Frisco ISD’s published calendar. The separate ICS file is generated by MySchoolDates as a one-time import and does not update automatically.
